title: From sketch to App Store release: iOS and macOS app development
description: I build iOS and macOS apps from the first sketch to App Store release, fix code AI wrote for you, and support apps already live.
body:
In 2024, the App Store earned $103.4 billion (Business of Apps, July 2025), while the App Store ecosystem facilitated $1.3 trillion in billings and sales in 2024 (Apple, 2025 report). The platform pays, and the work of getting an app onto it is something I do for clients.

I am an iOS and macOS developer with experience since 2011. I am an entrepreneur with 10+ years behind me and over 100 launched apps. If you want to launch a new app, support an existing one, or expand your business, I can help bring the idea to life.

## From sketch to App Store release

You bring an idea, even a rough sketch. I build the app and take it through to the App Store release.

I work on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac apps. The stack is Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit and AppKit. If your app needs AI features, I add them with Apple Foundation Models, Vision and Apple Intelligence.

## Fix what AI wrote for you

Some people build a first version with AI tools and then get stuck. The code runs in a demo and breaks in real use, or it never gets through App Store review.

I read what was written, fix it, and bring it to a state you can ship and maintain.

## Support for your current app

If your app is already live, I can take over ongoing support. That covers fixes, updates and new features, so the app keeps working as iOS and macOS change.

## Other work

Beyond apps, I build agentic AI systems: custom agent harnesses, autonomous long-running agents, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP tool integrations with OAuth and Cloudflare Workers.

## Get in touch

Tell me what you want to build or what needs fixing. Write through the [contact form](https://resrom.com/projects/contact).
